homes.welcomeText: Start with your home. Give it a name, then add its rooms, storage and things, so you always know where everything is.
homes.newText: Another flat, a country house or your parents' place: each home keeps its own places, things and people.
homes.name: Name

places.title: Places and things
places.emptyText: Start with the property itself: a flat, a house or a plot. Rooms, storage and things go inside it.

entity.readOnly: You can see this, but not change it.
entity.notFoundText: This place or thing does not exist, or you cannot see it.

fields.name: Name
fields.aliasesHint: What else you call it, separated by commas. Search finds these too.

create.title: Add a place or thing
create.nothingInside: Nothing can be added inside this place.

move.title: Move {{name}}
move.hint: Pick the new place. Only places where it fits can be picked.

archive.title: Archive {{name}}
archive.text: It leaves the tree but keeps its history, and you can restore it later.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The link may be broken, or the page has moved.

errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection and try again.
errors.internal_error: The server ran into a problem. Try again later.
errors.validation_error: Some of the values are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.stale_version: Someone changed this in the meantime. You now see the latest version: check it and try again.
errors.entity_not_found: This place or thing does not exist, or you cannot see it.
errors.home_not_found: This home does not exist, or you have no access to it.
errors.misplaced_entity: It cannot go there. Pick another place.
errors.invalid_entity: Check the name, the other names and the quantity.
errors.invalid_home: Check the name and the time zone.
errors.entity_archived: It is archived. Restore it first.
errors.permission_denied: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again {{wait}}.
errors.invalid_setup_token: This setup token does not work. Copy the token from the server's latest log: every restart makes a new one.
errors.already_set_up: Penaria is already set up. Sign in instead.
errors.weak_password_too_short: The password needs at least {{min_length}} characters.
errors.weak_password_too_long: The password can have at most {{max_length}} characters.
errors.weak_password_common: This password is one of the most common ones. Choose another.
errors.invalid_account_username: A username has 3 to 32 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.
errors.session_not_found: This device is already signed out.
errors.cross_origin_request: The request came from another site and was refused. Open Penaria at its own address.
errors.invalid_passkey: This passkey does not work here. It may have been removed from your account: sign in with your password instead.
errors.passkey_rejected: The passkey could not be checked. Try again.
errors.passkey_not_found: This passkey has already been removed.
errors.invalid_passkey_name: A passkey's name needs 1 to {{max_length}} characters.
errors.last_sign_in_method: This passkey is your only way to sign in, so it cannot be removed.
errors.escalation: You cannot give more access than you have yourself.
errors.invalid_grant: Check the role, the place and the dates.
errors.invalid_grant_expires_at: Check the dates: the end must be in the future, and a guest link works for 90 days at most.
errors.invalid_grant_grant_expires_at: The last day of access must be in the future, and an owner's access never ends.
errors.invalid_grant_scope_entity_id: This place is not in this home.
errors.invalid_grant_role_id: A guest link needs a role for guests.
errors.invalid_grant_leave_when_accepted: Only an owner invitation hands the home over.
errors.invalid_grant_name: A guest link's name needs 1 to {{max_length}} characters.
errors.role_not_found: This role does not exist in this home.
errors.grant_not_found: This access has already been changed or taken back. Look at the list again.
errors.last_owner: A home needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.owner_grant: An owner's access is not changed. Invite a new owner, or take an owner's access back.
errors.invitation_not_found: This invitation link does not work. Check it, or ask for a new one.
errors.invitation_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.invitation_used: This invitation has already been used. Each invitation works once: ask for a new one.
errors.own_invitation: This is your own invitation. Pass the link on to the person it is for.
errors.already_granted: You already have this access to this home.
errors.inviter_lost_access: The person who invited you can no longer give this access. Ask them for a new invitation.
errors.guest_link_not_found: This guest link does not work. Check it, or ask your hosts for a new one.
errors.guest_link_ended: This guest link has expired or was revoked. Ask your hosts for a new one.
errors.username_taken: This username is taken. Choose another.
errors.own_grant: You cannot change your own access. Ask someone else who manages the home's people.
errors.invalid_grant_valid_days: An invitation works for 1 to 30 days.
errors.invalid_grant_grant: A guest link's access is not changed. Make a new link instead.
errors.install_admin_required: Only an admin of this Penaria can do this.
errors.mailbox_locked: The server's environment sets the mailbox, so it cannot be changed here.
errors.mail_off: This Penaria sends no email. Connect a mailbox in Settings, or pass the link on by hand.
errors.invalid_mailbox_host: The server is a host name or an address, such as smtp.example.org.
errors.invalid_mailbox_from_name: The sender's name has at most {{max_length}} characters.
errors.invalid_email: This does not look like an email address.
errors.invalid_email_to: Type the address to send the test to.
errors.account_link_not_found: This link does not work. Check it, or ask for a new one.
errors.account_link_expired: This link has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.account_link_used: This link has already been used. Ask for a new one.
errors.reset_not_allowed: You cannot reset this person's password: they have access you could not give. They can reset it by email, or ask someone who can.
errors.mail_not_found: This email is no longer in the log.
errors.mail_expired: This email can no longer be sent: its link stopped working, or it is too old.
errors.mail_queued: This email is waiting for its next attempt already.
errors.invalid_mailbox_password: The server or the login changed: enter the password again, so the saved one never goes to another server.
errors.wrong_code: The code is wrong or was already used. Wait for the next code and try again.
errors.second_factor_expired: Signing in took too long. Go back and sign in again.
errors.second_factor_code_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app too.
errors.totp_enrolment_not_found: Setting up took too long. Cancel and start again.
errors.totp_unreadable: The code from the app cannot be checked on this server. Use a recovery code instead.
errors.last_second_factor: Owners and admins need a second step to sign in. Add a passkey before you turn the authenticator app off.
errors.second_factor_required: Add a passkey or an authenticator app first: owners and admins need a second step to sign in.

setup.title: Set up Penaria
setup.text: Create the first account. It manages this install and owns the homes it creates.
setup.tokenText: The server printed a one-time setup token to its log when it started. It proves that you have access to the machine. With Docker Compose, run:
setup.tokenRestart: Each restart prints a new token, and the old one stops working.
setup.usernameHint: You sign in with it: 3 to 32 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.
setup.displayNameHint: What others in your homes see.

password.tooShort: The password needs at least {{min}} characters.
password.hint: At least {{min}} characters. A few unrelated words make a good one.

account.title: Account
account.passwordChanged: The password is changed. Your other devices were signed out.
account.sessionsText: Sign out a device you do not recognise or no longer use.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.text: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of a password. A passkey stays on your phone or computer, or in your password manager, and cannot be guessed or lured out by a fake site.
passkeys.orPassword: or with your username and password
passkeys.added: The passkey is added. Next time, sign in with it.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys at this address. Passkeys need Penaria opened over https at a domain name.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.removeText: You will no longer be able to sign in with it. To tidy up, also delete it on the device or in the password manager that keeps it.
passkeys.suggestionTitle: Sign in faster with a passkey
passkeys.suggestionText: Next time, use your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of typing your password.

failure.cancelled: No passkey was used. Try again.
failure.exists: This device already keeps a passkey for your account.
failure.unavailable: Passkeys do not work at this address. Open Penaria over https at its domain name.

reauthenticate.title: Confirm it's you
reauthenticate.text: This is a sensitive change. Confirm it's you first.

twoStep.title: Two-step sign-in
twoStep.text: With an authenticator app, signing in with your password also asks for a six-digit code from your phone. Passkeys need no code.
twoStep.scan: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or Bitwarden. Or type the key into it by hand.
twoStep.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
twoStep.codeHint: Six digits; the app shows a new code every 30 seconds.
twoStep.codesText: If you lose your phone, sign in with one of these codes instead of a code from the app. Each code works once. Keep them somewhere safe: they are shown only now.
twoStep.turnOffText: Signing in with your password will no longer ask for a code, and your recovery codes will stop working. You can also remove Penaria from the authenticator app.
twoStep.enterCode: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
twoStep.enterRecoveryCode: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works once.

secondFactorPrompt.title: Add a second step to sign in
secondFactorPrompt.text: You own a home or run this Penaria, so a password alone is not enough to protect it. Add a passkey or an authenticator app. Until then, you cannot hand over a home, change people's access or change the settings.
secondFactorPrompt.passkeyText: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock. A passkey needs no password and no code.
secondFactorPrompt.appText: Keep your password, and confirm each sign-in with a six-digit code from your phone.

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Everything, including other owners and deleting the home.

admin.name: Admin
admin.description: Everything except owners: things, devices, tasks, people and settings.

family.name: Family member
family.description: Adds and changes things, uses devices and marks tasks done. Does not see private places.

guest.name: Guest
guest.description: Sees only what is marked for guests and where it is, and uses devices. Access ends on its own.

contractor.name: Contractor
contractor.description: Sees things and tasks and marks tasks done. Best limited to one place.

share.onlyNow: The link is shown only now: Penaria keeps no copy of it. Lost it? Make a new one.

people.title: People and access
people.guestLinksText: A guest needs no account. The link opens a view of what is marked for guests and ends on its own.
people.notManager: Only those who manage the home's people see who has access and invite others.
people.leaveSectionText: You lose access to the home. To come back, someone has to invite you again.
people.leaveText: The home disappears from your list, and you will need a new invitation to come back.
people.removeText: {{name}} loses the access of the role “{{role}}” at once.
people.onePlaceHint: Access covers the place and everything inside it.
people.pickPlace: Pick a place, or choose the whole home.
people.endsOptional: Leave it empty for access without an end.

invite.title: Invite to the home
invite.transfer: Hand the home over to them
invite.transferHint: When they accept, you stop being an owner. Use it to transfer ownership.
invite.readyWhole: Pass this link on to the person you invite. They join the whole home as “{{role}}”. The link works once, until {{until}}.
invite.readyPlace: Pass this link on to the person you invite. They join as “{{role}}”, in {{place}} only. The link works once, until {{until}}.
invite.emailHint: Optional. The link goes there too, in the home's language.

guestLink.title: Guest link
guestLink.text: Anyone with the link sees what is marked for guests and the places on the way to it. No account needed.
guestLink.name: Name
guestLink.nameHint: Such as “Weekend guests”. Only you and those who manage the home's people see it.
guestLink.noRole: This home has no role for guests.
guestLink.readyWhole: Anyone with this link or QR code can look around the home until {{until}}. Print it for the fridge or send it to your guests.
guestLink.readyPlace: Anyone with this link or QR code can look around {{place}} until {{until}}. Print it for the fridge or send it to your guests.

invitation.title: {{name}} invites you to {{home}}
invitation.transfer: You will become an owner of the home, and {{name}} will stop being one.
invitation.newAccountText: Choose a username and a password. You can add a passkey afterwards.
invitation.haveAccountText: Sign in, then accept the invitation with your account.

guest.signedInText: You are signed in as {{name}}. To see the home as a guest, this browser signs you out of your account.
guest.continue: Sign out and continue as a guest
guest.endedText: This guest link has expired or was revoked. Ask your hosts for a new one.
guest.nothingText: Your hosts have not marked anything for guests.
guest.footnote: You see only what your hosts marked for guests. Access ends on its own.

settings.title: Settings
settings.text: The settings of this Penaria. They apply to every home on it, and only its admins see them.

mail.title: Mail (SMTP)
mail.text: Password resets, email confirmations, invitations and account notices go out through this mailbox.
mail.offNotice: Mail is off. Until a mailbox is connected, reset and invitation links are shown on screen to pass on by hand, and accounts cannot add an email.
mail.lockedNotice: The server's environment sets this mailbox (PENARIA_MAIL__*), so it cannot be changed here. Change the variables on the server and restart it.

issue.fromInvalid: This does not look like an email address.
issue.passwordAgain: The server or the login changed: enter the password again.

mail.hostHint: The address of the mail server, such as smtp.example.org.
mail.securityHint: STARTTLS suits most servers. Changing it moves the port to its usual one.
mail.usernameHint: The account that sends the emails. Leave it empty if the server needs no sign-in.
mail.passwordHint: Write-only: it is never shown again.
mail.passwordSetHint: Leave it empty to keep the saved password.
mail.fromAddressHint: People see this address in the From field.
mail.fromNameHint: Shown next to the address, such as the name of your home.

test.title: Test email
test.text: Checks the saved settings. Leave the address empty to send it to your own email.
test.needMailbox: Connect a mailbox and save it first.
test.saveFirst: Save your changes first: the test checks the saved settings.
test.needAddress: Your account has no email: type the address to send the test to.
test.failed: The email was not sent. The server said:
test.toInvalid: This does not look like an email address.

mailLog.title: Mail log
mailLog.text: Every email Penaria sent or tried to send in the last 30 days, with each attempt. Temporary failures are tried again after 1, 5, 15 and 30 minutes.
mailLog.emptyText: Emails appear here once Penaria sends them.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.text: Type your username or the email of your account. If the account has a confirmed email, a link to choose a new password goes there; it works for 30 minutes.
forgot.sent: If an account with a confirmed email matches, a link is on its way. Check your inbox, and the spam folder too.
forgot.noMail: This Penaria sends no email. Ask an admin of your home for a reset link: they can make one on the People page. The owner of the server can make one too.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.signsOut: Every device signed in to the account is signed out. Passkeys keep working.
reset.done: The password is set, and every device was signed out. Sign in with the new password.
reset.passkeysText: They keep working. If you do not recognise one, sign in and remove it on your account page.

verifyEmail.title: Confirming your email
verifyEmail.done: {{email}} is now the email of your account.

email.title: Email
email.text: Password reset links and notices about your account go to this address. Nobody else in your homes sees it.
email.noMail: This Penaria sends no email yet, so an address cannot be confirmed. Ask the admin of the install to connect a mailbox.
email.hint: We send a link there; the address is yours once you open it.
email.sent: A link went to {{email}}. Open it within 24 hours to confirm the address.

resetLink.title: Reset the password of {{name}}
resetLink.text: Make a link that lets {{name}} choose a new password, and pass it on by hand. It works once, for 24 hours. {{name}} is signed out everywhere; their passkeys keep working.
resetLink.ready: Pass this link on to {{name}}. It works once, until {{until}}.
